feature: the design at a glance (Etsy first photo: one product, no text)
prompt: The ring stands upright on the pale travertine surface, seen from a three-quarter front angle a little above it. The baguette faces the camera on the part of the band nearest the lens, where it reads as a short, bright bar running across the band from edge to edge; the full circle of the band is visible and nothing is cut off. The ring sits in the centre of the frame and fills a little more than half of the frame's height, with generous space on the left and right so that a square crop keeps the whole ring. A soft amber patch of light lies on the plaster wall behind it and a faint teal patch on the travertine to one side. The ring is the only object in the image. The ring: a solid 14K yellow gold band, 6 mm wide and 2.2 mm thick, with a flat outer face and crisp, squared edges. The outer face has a fine, even brushed satin finish, its soft grain running around the band; the inside is smooth high polish. One single lab-grown diamond baguette, bright and colourless: a narrow straight baguette with square corners, three times as long as it is wide, about 6 x 2 mm. It is set crosswise, at right angles to the band's direction around the finger: its long sides run straight across the band from one edge of the band to the other, so the stone spans the full 6 mm width of the band and is only 2 mm long in the direction the band runs. Its top sits level with the brushed face, and the gold meets its two long sides in clean straight lines. The stone is not laid lengthwise along the band, and it is not an emerald cut and not a square stone. It is the only stone on the ring: no other diamonds, no pave, no prongs, no claws, no raised bezel, no engraving, no hallmark, no text. Setting: a natural home studio in soft late-afternoon daylight from a large window, with a warm ivory lime-plaster wall, pale travertine and light oak surfaces, and undyed natural linen. Gentle patches of coloured light fall across the surfaces nearby, honey amber and soft teal, cast by sunlight through coloured glass outside the frame. Controlled metal reflections: the metal shows broad, soft reflections with no blown-out highlights, no hard white streaks and no mirror-chrome look, and it keeps its true natural colour, never orange or over-saturated. A diamond in view may catch a small flash of the amber or teal light. Photorealistic product photograph, natural colour, sharp focus on the jewellery, gentle shallow depth of field. No text, no logo, no watermark, no packaging. Reference images: both show this ring's design.
